answer: By binding each agent identity to a hardware-rooted attestation anchor and a bonded stake, the economy forces every new node to prove physical uniqueness before transacting. Nodes gossip identity claims as a low-bandwidth whisper that propagates a signed plume of provenance metadata across the fault-containment network, letting peers cross-validate lineage without central. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
